newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight sees new enquiries in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight sees new enquiries in slow market.

text.p: New enquiries were added to sugar freight orders on Tuesday, but overall business remained uneventful amid a dearth of fixtures, shipbrokers said.
"The market is steady but unspectacular," said one shipbroker.
Cargoes were being shipped regularly out of Brazil, but sellers needed a a few options on discharge points as their cargoes were often unsold at the time of the fixture.
There were no fixtures on Monday when the London market was closed for a Bank holiday, or on Tuesday, brokers said.
